item.bentobox.wooden_chopsticks.tooltip: Right-click food in an open bento to pick up one serving.
item.bentobox.wooden_chopsticks.loaded_t: Hold right-click away from the bento to eat.
item.bentobox.wooden_chopsticks.remove_t: Right-click a compartment to return food; Shift + right-click in air to remove it.
item.bentobox.wooden_chopsticks.no_room: This compartment is full or holds a different food.
item.bentobox.wooden_chopsticks.full: You are full. Shift + right-click in air to remove the food.
